本表所列的價格數據只作指標及參考用途。價格變動百分率與公營建築工程的材料成本指數變動百分率可能不一樣。價格變動百分率會受到用以計算該平均價格的材料組合及／或其品質的改變及／或優惠幅度所影響，而材料成本指數則為量度純粹價格變動而設。材料成本指數刊登於政府憲報及載於政府統計處網站(https://www.censtatd.gov.hk/tc/scode330.html)。
本表所列的批發價是指船邊價，或貨倉交貨價，或出廠價（即不包括送貨到買家的運輸成本）。
@ 本表所列的價格是公營建築工程的材料成本指數(2021年4月=100)中選定建築材料的平均批發價格；而有關材料成本指數(2003年4月=100)中的特選建築材料平均批發價格數據亦可供索取。
* 碎石的平均價格是根據本地及進口碎石的價格而編製的。進口碎石的價格是以到岸價計算（即貨物運抵香港的成本，包括保險費及運費等）。
** 自2011年10月起的平均柴油價格已把油公司的主要優惠計算在內。因此，此後的平均價格不能與以前的直接比較。
^ 數字包括低揮發性有機化合物油漆。
^^ 數字不包括海砂及機製砂。
有關本刊物的查詢，請聯絡政府統計處物價研究分析組（二）。

Notes:

Price data provided in this list are for indication and reference purposes only.  The percentage changes in the price level may be different from the percentage changes in the index numbers of the costs of materials used in public sector construction projects.  While changes in the price level may be affected by changes in the mix and/or quality of the materials and/or extent of discount used for calculating the average prices, the index numbers are intended for measuring pure price changes.  The index numbers are published in the government gazette and are available at the website of Census and Statistics Department (https://www.censtatd.gov.hk/en/scode330.html).
The wholesale price in this list refers to the along-side-ship price, or ex-godown price or ex-factory price (i.e. excluding transportation cost to purchasers' site).

@ The prices in this list are the average wholesale prices of selected building materials covered in the index numbers of the costs of materials used in public sector construction projects (Apr  2021 = 100).  The list of average wholesale price data of selected building materials covered in the costs of materials index numbers series (Apr 2003 = 100) are available upon request.

* Data for the local and imported aggregates are used to compile the average price of aggregates.  The price of imported aggregates is on c.i.f. basis (i.e. cost of goods on arrival in Hong Kong, including insurance and freight etc.).

** For the average prices of diesel fuel since October 2011, major price concessions from oil companies had been incorporated in the compilation.  Thus, the average prices thereafter cannot be compared directly with those before.
